functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41c5e0 calls HudUiNewGamePanelOverlayOwner::StaticInit and tail-calls RegisterAtExit. Assembly for 0x41c5f0 validates class construction with a table pointer at object offset zero and clears m_panel.

Current Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41c6a0 calls atexit with HudUiNewGamePanelOverlayOwner::AtExitDestructor. Assembly for 0x41c6b0 tail-calls HudUiNewGamePanelOverlayOwner::Destructor on the global owner.

Current Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41c630 calls the active panel SetEnabled operation with 0 when present, reloads m_panel, dispatches generated deleting-destructor cleanup with flag 1 when still present, clears m_panel, and leaves base-class teardown to generated C++ destructor cleanup.

Current Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41c610 calls HudUiNewGamePanelOverlayOwner::Destructor, conditionally calls operator delete when flags bit 0 is set, and returns self; the owner entry is provider-boundary.

Historical native smoke coverage verified StaticInit, AtExitDestructor, direct Destructor, deleting and non-deleting scalar destructor paths, RegisterAtExit, and StaticInitAndRegisterAtExit using real constructed new-game panels under isolated option/video state.
